H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H216: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H4581: a fortified place; figuratively, a defence
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H6342: to be startled (by a sudden alarm); hence, to fear in general
H7126: to approach (causatively, bring near) for whatever purpose
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H7489: properly, to spoil (literally, by breaking to pieces); figuratively, to make (or be) good fornothing, i.e. bad (physically, socially or morally)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
H6862: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble ; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
H3782: to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall
H5307: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H2583: properly, to incline; by implication, to decline (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically, to pitch atent; gen. to encamp (for abode or siege)
H4264: an encampment (of travellers or troops); hence, an army, whether literal (of soldiers) or figurative (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H4421: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H7592: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H1245: to search out (by any method, specifically in worship or prayer); by implication, to strive after
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H2372: to gaze at; mentally to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically, to have avision of
H5278: agreeableness, i.e. delight, suitableness, splendor or grace
H1239: properly, to plough, or (generally) break forth, i.e. (figuratively) to inspect, admire, care for, consider
H1964: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H6845: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk
H5520: a hut (as of entwined boughs); also a lair
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H5641: to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively
H5643: a cover (in a good or a bad, a literal or a figurative sense)
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H6697: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous)
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H6258: at this time, whether adverb, conjunction or expletive
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H5439: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
H2076: to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice)
H2077: properly, a slaughter, i.e. the flesh of an animal; by implication, a sacrifice (the victim or the act)
H8643: clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangorof trumpets, as an alarum
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H5186: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H5203: properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.)
H5800: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H1: father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application
H517: a mother (as the bond of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively (like father))
H622: to gather for any purpose; hence, to receive, take away, i.e. remove (destroy, leave behind, put up, restore, etc.)
H3384: properly, to flow as water (i.e. to rain); transitively, to lay or throw (especially an arrow, i.e. to shoot); figuratively, to point out (as if by aiming the finger), to teach
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H5148: to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists)
H734: a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan
H4334: a level, i.e. a plain (often used (with the article prefix) as a proper name of certain districts); figuratively, concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) justice (sometimes adverbially, justly)
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H8324: to be hostile (only active participle an opponent)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H5707: concretely, a witness; abstractly, testimony; specifically, a recorder, i.e. prince
H8267: an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)
H2555: violence; by implication, wrong; by meton. unjust gain
H539: properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain;
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H2898: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H6960: to bind together (perhaps by twisting), i.e. collect; (figuratively) to expect
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H2388: to fasten upon; hence, to seize, be strong (figuratively, courageous, causatively strengthen, cure, help, repair, fortify), obstinate; to bind, restrain, conquer
H553: to be alert, physically (on foot) or mentally (in courage)
